chunks: I found a statement by some of the later scholars which he raised as a counter-argument to the words of Al-Murtada (may Allah have mercy on him) regarding the Occultation, and he thought that he had succeeded in finding a profound point, so he adorned it with falsehood for those who lack insight and perception of the aspects of reasoning, and I will discuss it.

key_terms.الْمُرْتَضَى: Al-Murtada (Sayyid Al-Hasan ibn Al-Husayn Al-Murtada), a prominent Shia scholar
key_terms.وُجُوهِ النَّظَرِ: Aspects of reasoning or modes of argumentation

ai.seo_question: How does Al-Tusi critique the later scholar's argument against Al-Murtada regarding the Occultation?
ai.summary: Al-Tusi sets the stage for his defense of Al-Murtada’s doctrine of the Occultation by identifying a specific critique from later scholars that he deems superficial. He characterizes the critic as having mistaken a weak argument for a decisive victory, appealing to readers who lack the intellectual depth to discern the nuances of the debate. This introduction highlights the rigorous dialectical tradition within Shia scholarship, where defending the Imamate against internal and external challenges was paramount.
